exclude-git-push.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-git-commit.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

skip-git-commit.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

skip-git-push.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-export-push.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-stack-push.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-stack-sync.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-stack-submit.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

skip-stack-submit.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

local-config-write-skip.note: Writes a skip into lefthook's local config, which leaves the step out of every later push.

local-config-edit-exclude.note: Adds an exclude_tags entry to lefthook's local config, which leaves the lint steps out of every later commit.

local-config-shell-skip.note: Writes a skip into lefthook's local config, which leaves the step out of every later push.

config-git-commit.note: Runs the pre-commit hook from a config the agent chose, in place of the repository's own lefthook config.

config-git-push.note: Runs the pre-push hook from a config the agent chose, in place of the repository's own lefthook config.

config-stack-submit.note: Runs the hooks of every push in the stack from a config the agent chose, in place of the repository's own lefthook config.

hooks-path-git-commit.note: Points git at a hooks folder with no hooks, so the commit runs none of the repository's checks.

hooks-path-git-push.note: In a linked worktree .git is a file, so .git/hooks names no folder and the push runs no hooks.

hooks-path-stack-push.note: Sets git's hooks folder through the environment gh stack passes to git, so the stack pushes run no hooks.

plain-git-push.note: Pushes the task branch with every hook step on.

plain-stack-submit.note: Submits the stack with every hook step on.

empty-exclude-push.note: An empty LEFTHOOK_EXCLUDE leaves no step out.

local-config-write-output.note: Changes only what lefthook prints; every step still runs.

config-kept-push.note: Names the lefthook config the worktree already loads, so every step runs.

hooks-path-kept-commit.note: Names the repository's own hooks folder, so the commit runs every hook.

hooks-path-kept-stack-submit.note: Names the repository's own hooks folder, so every push in the stack runs every hook.

bin-git-commit.note: Runs a program that does nothing in place of lefthook, so the commit runs none of the repository's checks.

bin-git-push.note: Runs a script of the agent's choosing in place of lefthook, so the push runs none of the repository's checks.

bin-stack-push.note: Runs a program that does nothing in place of lefthook for every git command the stack push runs.

parameters-git-commit.note: Points git at a hooks folder with no hooks through GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, so the commit runs none of the repository's checks.

parameters-git-push.note: Points git at another hooks folder through GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, so the push runs none of the repository's checks.

parameters-stack-sync.note: Sets git's hooks folder through the environment gh stack passes to git, so the stack sync runs no hooks.

global-config-git-commit.note: Swaps the user's git config for one that sets another hooks folder, so the commit runs none of the repository's checks.

global-config-git-push.note: Swaps the user's git config for one in the worktree that sets another hooks folder, so the push runs none of the repository's checks.

global-config-stack-submit.note: Swaps the user's git config for one auto-mode cannot read, which can set another hooks folder for every push in the stack.

bin-kept-push.note: Names the worktree's own lefthook binary, so the push runs every hook.

parameters-kept-commit.note: Names the repository's own hooks folder, so the commit runs every hook.

global-config-kept-push.note: Swaps in an empty git config, and the repository's hooks folder stays, so the push runs every hook.

system-config-git-commit.note: Swaps the system git config for one that sets another hooks folder, so the commit runs none of the repository's checks.

system-config-git-push.note: Swaps the system git config for one in the worktree that sets another hooks folder, so the push runs none of the repository's checks.

system-config-stack-sync.note: Swaps the system git config for every git command the stack sync runs, so its pushes run none of the repository's checks.

no-system-kept-push.note: Skips a system git config that sets no hooks folder, so the push runs every hook.

expanded-count-git-push.note: Sets core.hooksPath through GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 with a count the shell expands, so the push may run none of the repository's checks.

expanded-key-stack-submit.note: Builds the core.hooksPath key with a command substitution, so the stack's pushes may run none of the repository's checks.

expanded-option-key-git-push.note: Names a config key through a shell variable, which can set core.hooksPath and skip every hook the push runs.

expanded-config-env-key-git-commit.note: Names a config key through a shell variable, which can set core.hooksPath and skip every hook the commit runs.

expanded-subcommand-git-commit.note: Reads git's subcommand from a shell variable, which can hold commit --no-verify and skip every hook the commit runs.

expanded-options-git-push.note: Reads push options from a shell variable, which can hold --no-verify and skip every hook the push runs.

substituted-message-git-commit.note: Reads the commit message from a file; the substitution fills one quoted message word, so every hook step stays on.
